newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Kemayan buys Australian hotel.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Kemayan buys Australian hotel.

text.p: Kemayan Corp Bhd said on Friday it has acquired Cambridge Hotel in Sydney for A$29.7 million cash from Emmons Mt Gambier Pty Ltd.

In a statement, Kemayan said the acquisition, through its Australian subsidiary United Group Unit Trust, is financed by A$13.5 million convertible loan and borrowing from National Mutual of Australia.

Kemayan also said in a separate statement that it has entered into an agreement to acquire a piece of land together with a seven-storey hotel under construction in southern Malaysian state of Malacca for 28 million ringgit.
Upon completion, the three-star Grand Hill Hotel will consist of 112 rooms.
Kemayan said the acquisitions would further enhance the group's hotel portfolio. Kemayan is involved in property and plantations.
